def twoSum (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : twoSum_precond (nums) (target)) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match nums.length with
  | 0 => none
  | _ =>
      let rec findPair (i : Nat) (remaining : List Int) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
        if remaining.isEmpty then none
        else
          let j := i + 1
          if i + 1 < remaining.length + i then
            let head := remaining.head?
            match head with
            | some v =>
                if nums[i]! + v = target then
                  some (i, j)
                else
                  findPair i (remaining.tail)
            | none => none
          else none
      let rec search (i : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
        if i >= nums.length then none
        else
          let current := nums[i]!
          let rest := nums.drop (i + 1)
          -- Check if current can form a pair with any element in rest
          let pairFound := rest.foldl (fun acc v =>
            if current + v = target then
              let j := i + 1 + (rest.foldl (fun cnt _ => cnt + 1) 0)
              some (i, j)
            else
              acc
          ) none

          match pairFound with
          | some p => pairFound
          | none => search (i + 1)
      search 0
